source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows the pinned united-with-hearers reading and preserves comparison.
key_decisions.before: For good news was proclaimed to us just as it was to them; but the message they heard did not benefit them, because it was not united with trust in people who heard.
key_decisions.after: For we too have received good news just as they did, but the message they heard did not benefit them because they were not united by faith with those who listened.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For good news was proclaimed to us just as it was to them; but the message they heard did not benefit them, because it was not united with trust in those who heard.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps present entry, oath and creation completion.
key_decisions.before: For we who have trusted enter that rest, just as God has said, “As I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter my rest,’” although God’s works were finished from the foundation of the world.
key_decisions.after: For we who have believed enter the rest, just as he said, “So I swore in my anger, ‘They will never enter my rest,’” though his works were finished from the foundation of the world.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For we who have trusted enter that rest, just as God has said, “As I swore in my wrath, ‘They shall not enter my rest,’” although God’s works were finished from the foundation of the world.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps named David, delayed today and repeated warning.
key_decisions.before: again God appoints a certain day—“Today”—saying through David so long afterward, in the words already quoted, “Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts.”
key_decisions.after: God again appoints a certain day—“Today”—speaking through David after so long a time, as quoted above: “Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: again God appoints a certain day—“Today”—saying through David so long afterward, in the words already quoted, “Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts.”

key_decisions.rationale: Uses Joshua to distinguish the Greek name from Jesus in context.
key_decisions.before: For if Joshua had given them rest, God would not have spoken later about another day.
key_decisions.after: For if Joshua had given them rest, God would not have spoken later about another day.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For if Joshua had given them rest, God would not have spoken later about another day.

key_decisions.before: So then, a Sabbath rest remains for the people of God,
key_decisions.after: So a Sabbath rest remains for God's people.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: So then, a Sabbath rest remains for the people of God,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps violent cutting image, all paired inner terms and judgment.
key_decisions.before: For the word of God is living and active, sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing to the dividing of soul and spirit, of joints and marrow, and discerning the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
key_decisions.after: For God's word is living and active, sharper than any double-edged sword, penetrating to the division of soul and spirit, joints and marrow, and judging the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For the word of God is living and active, sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing to the dividing of soul and spirit, of joints and marrow, and discerning the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves exposure, divine sight and accountability.
key_decisions.before: And no creature is hidden from God’s sight, but all are naked and laid bare to the eyes of the one to whom we must give account.
key_decisions.after: No creature is hidden before him; everything is naked and exposed to the eyes of the one to whom we must give account.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And no creature is hidden from God’s sight, but all are naked and laid bare to the eyes of the one to whom we must give account.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves sympathy, comprehensive testing and sinlessness.
key_decisions.before: For we do not have a priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but one who in every way has been tested as we are, yet without sin.
key_decisions.after: For we do not have a high priest unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but one who has been tested in every way as we are, yet without sin.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For we do not have a priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but one who in every way has been tested as we are, yet without sin.
